notes.title: EdNoKa is now Live for play testers!
notes.notes:
EdNoKa is now Live for play testers!

You have been chosen to try EdNoKa, please let us know how you find it.
The in-game "store" is deactivated for now but you already have access to all its items.

Best way to give us feedback is through the Community of EdNoKa.

Enjoy!
